l1_words.meaning: current or up to date, now in use
pleasant or likeable, friendly in manner
if necessary, as a possible alternative
a discussion or debate between people

pattern_explanation: The Polish words and their English look-alikes come from the same Latin and Greek roots, so the spellings stayed close while the meanings shifted over time.
false_friend_warning: The Polish word meaning current (transliterated aktualny) looks like the English word actually, which means in fact or really. A student who says the Polish word meaning current when they want to say actually changes the meaning, so use English current or up to date instead.
